answer: Stripping the watermark destroys the content, so 311 stolen pieces need 311 re-watermarking jobs. The watermark is checked against the registry on each use. The canyon is the wall and the summit is the gate: Content carries a watermark keyed to the owner's identifier. A farm of 311 aliases must climb the wall 311 times, the lagoon ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
